crossRefs.note: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
Hear this, you elders, And listen, all you inhabitants of the land. Has this ever happened in your days, or in the days…
If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there Yahweh your God will gather you, and from there…
He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the…
Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the…

translations.web: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as great as this thing is, or has been heard like it?
translations.bsb: Indeed, ask now from one end of the heavens to the other about the days that long preceded you, from the day that God created man on earth: Has anything as great as this ever happened or been reported?
translations.kjv: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard
translations.asv: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and from the one end of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?
